execution.defect_policy: Any source, manifest, test, product, evidence, or reviewer defect invalidates every prior result. Rebuild, regate, rerun every group, regenerate the evidence index, and restart both clean reviewer passes on the corrected frozen commit. Containment and cleanup still execute on the failed attempt.

proof_controller.outer_driver: Codex direct-argv controller with a fresh random invocation id and generation for every build/run attempt

bootstrap_evidence.creation: For each invocation the Codex direct-argv controller generates a fresh random non-authorizing id and generation, creates the resulting 0700 no-replace invocation root, captures the exact build stdout and stderr without a shell, writes build info and runner SHA-256, captures exact version stdout, and atomically writes plus file-and-directory-fsyncs the 0600 invocation-ready record before exec of invoke.
bootstrap_evidence.runner_import: Bootstrap accepts the record only from the exact --controller-bootstrap argument, validates the unique external bundle and its own actual run argv, then imports every artifact byte-for-byte with no-replace into controller-bootstrap/ under the fresh attempt root before the first group.
bootstrap_evidence.retry_rule: Every same-commit retry generates a different invocation id and generation and therefore a different no-replace root and runner binary; no existing controller bundle is reused, mutated, auto-discovered, or selected as latest.
bootstrap_evidence.interrupted_publication_rule: A crash before the invocation-ready record is durably sealed leaves only an inert uniquely named partial root. It has no receipt, attempt, runner invocation, or authority; no future invocation reads or mutates it. A retry generates a different identity/root, and only the exact record path passed in argv can be imported.
bootstrap_evidence.terminal_success: The running controller's exact current-proof-attempt.json:succeeded marker and its already-durable bound final index are the invocation terminal-success evidence; no post-succeeded controller artifact is required or allowed.

attempt_state_machine.authoritative_success_commit: the atomic current-proof-attempt.json transition from closing to succeeded, containing the already-fsynced final evidence index fingerprint
attempt_state_machine.active_receipt_rule: receipt_minted or live_proof requires the fixed attempt lock plus a verified anonymous controller-liveness read descriptor; succeeded requires the exact durable final-index fingerprint; all other or mismatching states expose settings/read-only shell only
attempt_state_machine.abandoned_rule: after binding port 9876, a server finding preparing checkpoint_sealed receipt_minted live_proof or closing without the matching held attempt lock and valid controller-liveness descriptor atomically marks failed, quarantines fixed checkpoint/receipt, and starts without live transport authority

crash_recovery.preparing: idempotently quarantine mismatching fixed authority and mark failed
crash_recovery.receipt_minted: controller EOF stops process group; next bind quarantines receipt/checkpoint and marks failed
crash_recovery.live_proof: controller EOF stops process group; next bind quarantines receipt/checkpoint and marks failed
crash_recovery.closing: remove uncommitted final index, quarantine receipt/checkpoint, mark failed
crash_recovery.succeeded: require exact receipt and final index fingerprints or quarantine and fail
